verdict.rationale: Cursor documents a Privacy Mode that keeps code out of training, and it is on by default for Enterprise. Cloud Agents store encrypted repo copies only temporarily while the agent runs. Zero Data Retention is referenced as a mode, though it does not apply with your own API keys. The Cloud Agents API also supports deleting and archiving agents. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention periods, documented deletion of stored chats/account data, clear docs on how ZDR is enabled and scoped, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
